name: wf-L08
delta: The SAME near-black field with the glowing '8', now the hand-lettered marker word 'GREAT' has snapped in just beside it so the two read as a slogan — '8' and 'GREAT', the rhyme that chose the target. Everything else held. Near-black ground, warm cream lettering, the one red accent underlining 'GREAT'. Clean flat 2.5D vector cartoon in The Second Take house style: even medium-thick #241a12 outline, flat cel with soft shading; marker lettering; near-black palette plus the single red accent #d7402b used only semantically; no photorealism, no on-screen narrator, no unrequested text beyond '8' and 'GREAT', no logos; 16:9.
